title: Measuring Dimensions of Self-Presentation in Twitter Bios and their Links to Misinformation Sharing
reasoning: The paper explicitly investigates and evaluates "religiosity as a critical dimensions of the self associated with misinformation sharing online." It presents new evidence and statistical results showing that presenting as more religious is strongly associated with misinformation sharing, with dedicated figures (4, 6, 8, 9) and discussion in the main text and appendix.
